programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: Jesus - The Man Who Became God
programme.desc: The historical significance of the Christian belief in Jesus's divinity, in terms of its effects on Western civilization; learning about different scholarly views of the historical Jesus; tracing the diversity of early Christian thought.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.desc: The accounts of divine mortals in the ancient world; the overlap between the human and divine worlds in Greco-Roman polytheistic religions; exploring three age-old models of divine men in both mythology and Christian scripture.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: Humans as Gods in the Greco-Roman World
programme.desc: Delving into the interface between the human and the divine in pagan cultures; examining narratives describing people born of the sexual union of gods with mortals; looking at cases of humans who were exalted to the status of gods.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: Gods Who Were Human in Ancient Judaism
programme.desc: Accounts of divine humans and other godlike beings within ancient Judaism; exploring conceptions of divine beings that appear in human form in Genesis and Exodus; studying narratives of humans who become angelic beings in other Jewish texts.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.desc: How beings other than the one true God could be considered God in ancient Judaism; learning about the divine figure of the Son of Man and the Jewish conception of a second God; how divine attributes of God were personified.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: The Life and Teachings of Jesus
programme.desc: Why the New Testament Gospels are the only useful early sources on Jesus's life; studying the criteria used by scholars to evaluate the Gospels as history; investigating Jesus's apocalyptic worldview, which envisioned the imminent end of history.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: Did Jesus Think He Was God?
programme.desc: Exploring what Jesus said about himself, as well as what he specifically preached; grasping the nature and purpose of Jesus's ethical teachings and his view of himself as a prophet of the coming kingdom; the Jewish conception of the Messiah.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.sub-title: The Death of Jesus - Historical Certainties
programme.desc: Reviewing the events surrounding Jesus's final days that are known with relative certainty; learning about his reasons for being in Jerusalem and the political tensions surrounding the Passover celebration there; his arrest, charges and trial.

programme.title: The Triumph of Christianity
programme.desc: An overview of Christianity, the role of Jesus's earliest followers, and a few theories to explain how it became the most widely practiced religion in the world.

programme.title: The Triumph of Christianity

programme.desc: Insight into the significance of paganism, a complex term used in the pre-Christian Roman Empire to refer to the polytheistic religions that were widely followed at the time.

programme.title: The Triumph of Christianity
programme.desc: Insight into the significance of Judaism, an ancient monotheistic religion that was initially practiced by many, including Jesus and his early followers.

programme.title: The Triumph of Christianity

programme.title: How Jesus Became God

programme.sub-title: Humans as Gods in the Greco-Roman World

programme.title: How Jesus Became God

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
